summary: Sabesp filed a 6-K under cover of Brazilian CVM Resolution 44 announcing changes to its Executive Board. Mr. Claudio Kawa Hermolin was appointed to lead a new Customer Experience Directorate, Ms. Débora Pierini Longo stepped down as Director of Operations and Maintenance to lead an Integrated Operations Center project, and Mr. Roberval Tavares will temporarily accumulate Engineering and Operation director roles. No transaction terms, stake %, or price are disclosed. The filing is purely organizational and does not qualify as a special situation like a forced departure or activist event. 📋 routine management reshuffle; no watch items.
